answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independent audits show it is duplicating another identity’s work or coordinating votes. Audits sample tasks unpredictably and compare behavioral traces, so an attacker cannot cheaply split one model across many accounts without risking repeated losses. A trellis of reputation weights rewards sustained, distinct contributions, while onyx-tier privileges require a long record. The tide of new accounts may still arrive, but each fake identity ties up capital and must survive costly scrutiny.
